job.job_description:
About us

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

Ensure the activities by holding the commitments in terms of quality, costs and deadlines.

Having strong expertise on AI / Machine learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI

Collaborate with Data AI experts, Software Engineers and Business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solutions related to AI/ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI

Research / Analysis, Exploration, Solution development, and Problem solving

Solid experience of Training, evaluating, and fine-tuning models for optimal performance.

Ownership of delivering AI/ML models with high precision outcomes

Experience with building, deploying, and enhancing large-scale machine learning models and algorithms within real-world product environments

Good knowledge of math, probability, and statistics, and algorithms; Ability to write robust code in Popular AI Programming languages

Ability to rapidly prototype and experiment with different models and algorithms

Good understanding of the business context and the ability to translate business problems into AI/ML solutions

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Passionate for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in AI, Gen AI etc.

About you

Must have strong and proven experience in Machine learning and Deep learning techniques and use of popular AI/ML frameworks

Must have good experience on various AI techniques: Machine learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI

Experience with building, deploying, and enhancing large-scale machine learning models and algorithms within real-world product environments

Solid experience and understanding of ML techniques such as: Data Preprocessing, Feature Engineering, Model selection, Hyperparameter Tuning, Validation, and Deployment

Develop multi AI agents and RAG systems for real-time decision-making, integrating tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom frameworks.

Good knowledge of math, probability, and statistics, and algorithms; Ability to write robust code in Popular AI Programming languages

Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements

Must be able to implement AI applications by using and fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs)

Experience with production support, technical analysis and problem solving

Hands on experience on Large Language Models (LLMs), text generation, or similar Generative AI applications

Must have good communication and presentation skills

Good to have: Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources

Good to have: Experience working with Cloud platforms (e.g. GCP, AWS, Azure) for model deployment, AI services and operation

Good to have: Working experience on a Python web framework (e.g. Flask/Django) would be a plus

Optional: Work on AI/ML services on Cloud infrastructure and various cloud managed services




You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What we offer

Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.


Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).


Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.


Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.


Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.


Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


Only your skills matter
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: dont hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
